# IFM family venv on the cluster ($VENV_IFM): k15_full, k15_pairs, k16_path_ifm, k17_varbench (IFM models),
# k17_freeze_ifm through k10_ifm.py and xllm-loop. Python >= 3.10 (xllm-loop uses `str | None` in a signature at import;
# fla-core, blobfile, nltk and transformers 5.8.0 declare >= 3.10). Built by cluster/env/setup_cluster.sh with
# --system-site-packages (torch from the node image, never installed here). xllm itself is not listed: the g0_xllm job
# builds it into this venv on a GPU node (cluster/env/build_xllm.sh, pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps -e).
# Pins = requirements_ifm.txt (the pilot venv, Python 3.12) for the packages the scripts and xllm import, except:
#   fla-core and flash-linear-attention 0.5.2 -> 0.4.2: 0.5.x declares torch >= 2.7.0; 0.4.2 is the newest release whose
#     metadata admits torch 2.6 (Requires-Dist torch, no bound) and it keeps the two imports xllm makes at load
#     (fla.modules.conv.triton causal_conv1d_fwd/_bwd, fla.ops.utils.prepare_chunk_indices); it asks for triton >= 3.2,
#     the triton of torch 2.6.
#   torch 2.11.0, torchvision 0.26.0, triton 3.6.0, nvidia-*, cuda-*: removed (node image).
# numpy 2.4.4, pandas 3.0.2 and scipy 1.17.1 need Python >= 3.11; on 3.10 the requirements_fasthost.txt pins apply.
